probe_notes.unload: Only a review spec and firefox-core.json were added/replaced in the archive for two one-case runs; test.ts, runner, mock and replay checker unchanged. Beacon URLs receive distinct test query markers. The second accepted beacon remains routed/pending until context closure. Extra POST is an ordinary fetch. R386_EXTRA_POST=0 removes only that extra fetch.
probe_notes.preliminary_attempt: A first route probe tried to distinguish the request body; BiDi did not expose it there, so no beacon was held. That preliminary green run is not evidence for the finding.
probe_notes.unit_environment: System python lacked pytest. The repo test venv ran 26 PASS + 3 GPG setup errors in the sandbox, then all 29 PASS with local sockets allowed. No failed product assertion in that setup attempt.
probe_notes.chromium_environment: First direct Playwright invocation failed before tests because vite was absent from PATH; rerun uses npx.

reproduction.selector: python <review>/vor-maschine.ff.r386.codex-selector.py <archive-root-at-29db35ca>; reads shipped selector and its scratch-repo fixture
reproduction.browser: Copy the review spec into the archive as lcnc-webui/e2e/codex-unload.spec.ts. In that archive only, replace firefox-core.json with required=[{file:codex-unload.spec.ts,titles:[the spec title]}], buildup=[]. Run scripts/test_select/firefox.py under the heavy lock with a fresh --out directory.
reproduction.false_green: R386_EXTRA_POST unset or 1. The second marked beacon is held; a fetch fills its count. All checks PASS.
reproduction.negative_control: R386_EXTRA_POST=0. Same held beacon, no extra fetch. firefox-core and firefox-executed FAIL after 5 seconds (received 1, expected >=2).
reproduction.pristine_validation: The original 86-case Firefox core was run before the probe. Original manifest was restored and probe spec removed before the Chromium dialog run.
